# Version 4.154.0
> **Skia m154 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.154.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.400/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews the Skia m154 engine update with refreshed package documentation. HarfBuzzSharp bindings now follow the bundled native source, including two small source-compatibility changes described below.

## Breaking Changes

- **UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 renamed to CCC132** — HarfBuzzSharp now uses HarfBuzz's corrected `CCC132` name for the value 132. Replace references to `UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133` with `UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC132` and rebuild. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))
- **GlyphFlags.Defined removed** — `GlyphFlags.Defined` was an aggregate mask rather than an independent option and is no longer exposed. Combine the concrete glyph flags your code requires when constructing a mask. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m154** — The bundled renderer moves to Skia m154 and includes the latest upstream Chrome m154 fixes. ([#4945](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4945), [#5054](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5054), [#5114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5114))

## API Surface

- **Package XML documentation is available to consumers** — SkiaSharp packages now ship compiler-generated XML documentation alongside the managed assemblies, improving API documentation in supported tooling. ([#5053](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5053), [#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064), [#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066), [#5078](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5078), [#5080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5080))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.400

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 now generates its bindings from the HarfBuzz revision bundled by Skia. The refresh corrects the Unicode combining-class name and removes the aggregate GlyphFlags.Defined mask.
